simulation_parameters.unit_mismatch_detail: Pre-simulation Step/Stop & Window Audit: Raw manual parameters had `step_time = 1 milliseconds` (`1@u_ms`) and `end_time = 60 microseconds` (`60@u_us`). 1) Step/Stop Inconsistency: `1 milliseconds` > `60 microseconds` violates `step_time <= end_time` (1 ms cannot be used as the timestep for a 60 us simulation); adjusted 60 us diagnostic timestep to `step_time = 1@u_us` (1 microseconds). 2) Insufficient Observation Window: `60 microseconds` << RC tau = 0.7523 s and target period T = 60/70 = 0.8571 s. To observe 5 complete cycles, required duration = 5 * 0.857143 s = `4.28571 seconds` (`end_time = 4.28571@u_time_s` with `step_time = 1@u_ms`).

step_stop_consistency.adjustment_reason: STEP/STOP INCONSISTENCY DETECTED (`step_time > end_time`): Raw `step_time = 1 milliseconds` (`1@u_ms`, 0.001 s) exceeds `end_time = 60 microseconds` (`60@u_us`, 6e-05 s). `1 milliseconds` cannot be used as the timestep for a `60 microseconds` simulation. Automatically adjusted raw-window diagnostic timestep to `step_time = 1@u_us` (1 microseconds) so `step_time <= end_time` (1e-06 s <= 6e-05 s). OBSERVATION WINDOW CORRECTION (`60 microseconds` -> `4.28571 seconds`): For target period T = 0.8571 s, observing 5 complete cycles requires `end_time = 5 * 0.857143 s = 4.28571 seconds` (`4.28571@u_time_s`, equivalent to `as_s(4.28571)`) with compatible `step_time = 1@u_ms` (1 milliseconds, satisfying `0 < 0.001 s <= 4.28571 s`).
